summary: Kenon Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing English translations of its subsidiary OPC Energy Ltd.'s periodic report for the six-month and three-month periods ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes OPC's Board of Directors report and unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements, as required for foreign private issuers. No special-situation event (merger, tender, activist, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed; it is a routine periodic report incorporating exhibits into an existing Form S-8 registration statement. The filing contains forward-looking statements about OPC's projects and operations but no M&A or corporate action terms. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are provided.
